facts.text: The manual describes ZIP System R-sheathing as an alternative to the water-resistive barrier 'prescribed in the International Residential Code (IRC) and International Building Code (IBC)', and points to ESR-3373 and ER-0482 for more information.
Footnote: 'EIFS should NOT be installed over ZIP System R-sheathing. Doing so will void the 30-year limited ZIP System warranty.'

Notes and limitations: not warranted or recommended for roof applications; 'not recommended for manufactured housing projects built under the federal building code administered by ... HUD'; cover within 180 days, after which a mechanically fastened WRB must be installed.

The fire-rated assemblies section says R-sheathing 'is limited to' listed assemblies: UL V302, UL V303 and UL V318 (1-hour interior) and UL U364 (1-hour exterior and interior). These UL listings are not attached.
The prescriptive IRC/IBC method applies 'when installed per Table 1'; ESR-3373 is cited for the allowable design values.
